crossRefs.note: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.
He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.
They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

translations.web: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.
translations.bsb: When they crossed to the other side, the disciples forgot to take bread.
translations.kjv: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
translations.asv: And the disciples came to the other side and forgot to take bread.
